rationale: Both independently surface the actual latent gap — the diffusion hunyuan_image3_transformer.py:2238 still calling the removed get_cache_scale, matching later issue #4891 — and both hit the ground truth's core ask by proposing a test that drives the mapper through the real AutoWeightsLoader instead of a fake param. Y presents the shared major finding with a cleaner reachability trace and precise fix, and adds solid grounding (default_weight_loader/maybe_remap_kv_scale_name behavior) that validates why the deleted manual branches are safe, but its claim that the new test 'never executes in CI' looks wrong given X's quoted amd-merge.yml invocation that would collect it. X is comparably grounded via explicit grep/CI-tool citations, but its write-up is cluttered with contradictory resolved/refuted scratchpad entries that hurt clarity and actionability despite valid underlying findings.
